# Engineering Tutorial: Designing a Reliable Service for Request Processing

## 1. Introduction

In modern distributed systems, the reliability of a service is not merely a feature—it is a foundational requirement. A reliable service is one that can accept requests, validate their integrity, process them according to business logic, and gracefully handle failures without data loss or corruption. This tutorial provides a comprehensive guide to designing such a service, covering architecture, implementation patterns, failure analysis, and testing strategies.
